title: amaysim: $60 Cashback on 365 Days 200GB (+20GB Bonus) Prepaid Plan for $175 (Ongoing $270) @ ShopBack
body:
Deal: amaysim: $60 Cashback on 365 Days 200GB (+20GB Bonus) Prepaid Plan for $175 (Ongoing $270) @ ShopBack

[Bahrgain Victorious] It said from 2-10 days with AusPost, but likely dependent on your location. I went with an eSim for ease.
[superozbargain] just wanted to double‑check whether eSIM purchases are eligible for cashback. The last time I claimed cashback with TopCashback for Boost Mobile, I was told that eSIM was not eligible. Can you confirm how eSIM is treated for cashback with this ShopBack deal?
[Bahrgain Victorious] I bought an eSim and I have had the cashback tracked
[star-ggg] @Bahrgain Victorious: Just cause it tracked doesn't mean it'll definitely pay out
[cx5] I did eSIM and can see the cash back tracked.
[Anthony8888] eSIM we can buy straight away from Amasim?
[Bodogbodog] I’m in Sydney and I received mine the next day - it was sent by express post
[PotsyMcGoon] Damn, I went with Onepass but this is cheaper. Anyone know if I can cancel/refund onepass if it hasn't been activated?
[shap08] i got the 25% off next recharge, so I think ill stay as it is $112.5
[jimojr] You can ask for a refund if you haven’t activated the SIM yet. Just contact customer service. I’ve done it once before.
[scud70] I'd rather the actual price be cheaper than rely on the cash back tracking… Last time with topcashback and amaysim I didn't get it and it took 4 months for them to "look into it" then they said after 4 months you gave us the wrong info…. The invoice order number etc that was in the email they sent was the wrong info apparently (made up bullshit)… Take the garaunteed discount over the possible one any day.
[jbw87] Anyone know when this finishes up or is it just for today?
[ozprash] Ouch. Bought it for 199 at Woolies last night with the 10% monthly discount. Anyone have experience returning unopened Sim at Woolies? Their T&C's mention no change of mind returns for Sim cards.
[Bahrgain Victorious] Worth asking at the service desk politely if its unopened with the receipt and lean toward it being a genuine mistake
[illumination] Pretty sure it won't work because SIMs are treated like gift cards when it comes to returns
[ggfatty] does not matter how polite he asked as once activated sim card there is no refund possible
unless store manager wants to manually pay you back
[momo1988] Thanks OP, I had been looking for something like this. Port took less than 5 minutes.
[Bahrgain Victorious] my eSim port was less than 5 minutes today from Coles Mobile
[fozzie] Now sim must be activated within 20 days! Getting even harder for the cashback. Annoying.
[Bodogbodog] 20 days to activate is exactly the same as last time - nothings changed
[tdonovic] Thats a bargain. Sorts me out for the next year! Thanks OP
[illumination] Yes but you have to turn on roaming first
[interlocal] I'm getting SMS on my amaysim (PAYG) overseas without any roaming packages
[illumination] Yes, that makes sense. I didn't say roaming package
I said turn on roaming
Not exactly the same thing
[Saddy] I'm already an Amaysim customer, will I have to port out before porting back in? Anyone know the cheapest option if that's the case?
[illumination] Probably this but you'll have to "waste" some of the 30 days included
But it's only $1 lol, I think you'd otherwise have to pay something like $2 for an Aldi SIM which has no credit/validity/plan at all
[nightelves] The $2 Aldi sim you still need to top up. Last time I weren't able to bypass the top-up.
[Bodogbodog] Yes - you have to be porting from another provider other than Amaysim
[Asti] Pretty good if you can get in the CB activation window
[Weshouldgetsushi] Luckily my Vodafone SIMs are running out just now. Can't wait to get away from their network.
[DingoBlue] What’s the quickest/easiest/cheapest way out and back in?
[7hil] Can this be used for an iPad? If 2FA is via text this can cause issues on data only devices.
[DingoBlue] Is there anything stopping you using this twice?
[Bodogbodog] Nothing at all however do it as two seperate transactions with ShopBack - not quantity 2 on one order. I’ve done this and both orders tracked with cashback
[brisneylander] My boost plan expires in October
Could i buy this now and activate it in October? I know i would miss the extra cash back but $175 for 12.month sim is pretty appealing.
[Bahrgain Victorious] Post does state it needs to be activated in 20 days
[roy2016] $175 offer ends 28th aug , stated on the amaysim page
[Bodogbodog] A lot of your questions can be answered by looking at the recent Amaysim deal and the questions and answers from that eg can I buy two, can I get an eSIM etc - https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/965202
[kiss] Still new to this 365 SIM thing. Can I renew my existing Amaysim 365 plan with this $175 (rather than the $270) and still keep the same mobile number ?
[pork chop] "New and existing amaysim customers, but it has to be a new service"
Does this deal apply to existing Amaysim customers? My amaysim expires next week so this is perfect timing. If not, kindly educate me.
[illumination] Yes "but it has to be a new service"
It means you can't just use it as a recharge for your existing service
[N B] I have an AmaySim PAYG Sim. In change plan options I can see $270 for 365 day plan. Does that mean existing users are not allowed to get this or is there any workaround?
[Himlord] is anyone having issue accessing URL via Shopback i am keep getting bad URL tired both on App and web browser
[HoshinoKanade] Just renewed $270 service a few days ago :(
This thing has to be a new service anyway…
[Sarquiss] Does anyone know whether I can claim 2 cashbacks, if I buy 2 Sim's in 2 separate transactions?
[John] Keep in mind Amaysim uses 0495 number which is not recognised by Whatsapp.
[Tomato] oh didn't know that! so any new numbers given out by amaysim will start with 0495 now? where can u find this info online?
[Borg] They dont support conference call i.e. place one call on hold, dial in another and have a 3 way chat. Not that many people use it but occasionally handy.
